description: Post-contact satisfaction surveys (CSAT, NPS, CES), one row per survey, covering 31.0% of interactions. Typed, normalized and checked from workspace.bronze.satisfaction_surveys. Scales are truncated (CSAT/CES 1-4, NPS 2-7; issue 17) and scores are drawn from a range set by was_resolved (issue 16: CSAT and CES 2-4 when resolved, 1-3 when not; NPS 5-7 vs 2-4): report relative KPIs only and never use scores as labels or features.

load.notes: Daily files partitioned by process_date (the interaction's business day). Incremental runs MERGE new Bronze rows by survey_id.

survey_id.description: Survey identifier (SRV- + 20 alphanumerics), trimmed and upper-cased. Primary key.

interaction_id.description: Surveyed interaction (call_center_interactions.interaction_id); 0 orphans. Same customer and agent as the interaction.

event_ts.description: Survey time (from survey_date), 1-24 h after the interaction started.

event_date.description: Calendar date of event_ts. Use this, not process_date, for daily aggregates.

process_date.description: The surveyed interaction's business-day cut-off, not the survey's (earlier than event_date in 79.5% of rows). Partition/pruning key only.

agent_id.description: Agent being rated (equals the interaction's agent_id).

survey_type.description: Survey instrument, upper-cased. One survey per interaction.

send_channel.description: Channel the survey was sent through.

main_score.description: Headline score. Observed scales are truncated: CSAT 1-4, CES 1-4, NPS 2-7 (standard scales are 1-5, 1-7 and 0-10). Resolved contacts score {2,3,4} and unresolved {1,2,3} on CSAT: a consequence of FCR, never a label.

nps_category.description: FIX: NPS category recomputed from main_score (0-6 Detractor, 7-8 Passive, 9-10 Promoter) for every NPS survey; NULL for CSAT and CES. Fills the 3,274 missing values; 0 promoters exist because the scale stops at 7.

nps_category_raw.description: NPS category as delivered; NULL for 3,274 of 63,668 NPS surveys, otherwise equal to nps_category.

question_1_text.description: Text of question 1 (one of three generic Spanish questions, unrelated to survey_type).

question_3_text.description: Text of question 3 (would contact again through this channel).

open_comments.description: Free-text comment (Spanish); NULL for 52.4% of surveys. May contain customer-written text: aggregate only.

comment_sentiment.description: Sentiment of open_comments. Post-contact: never a feature.

response_time_hours.description: Hours the customer took to answer, as delivered (observed 1.0-36.0). It does not equal the gap between the interaction and event_ts.

campaign_response_rate.description: Response rate of the survey campaign, in percent (observed 15-45).

checks.name: survey_id_format
checks.description: Identifier follows the SRV- + 20 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: interaction_id_format
checks.description: Interaction identifier follows the INT- + 16 alphanumerics pattern.

checks.name: main_score_in_standard_scale
checks.expr: main_score IS NULL OR CASE survey_type WHEN 'NPS' THEN main_score BETWEEN 0 AND 10 WHEN 'CSAT' THEN main_score BETWEEN 1 AND 5 WHEN 'CES' THEN main_score BETWEEN 1 AND 7 END
checks.description: Score lies on the instrument's standard scale (NPS 0-10, CSAT 1-5, CES 1-7).

checks.name: main_score_in_observed_scale
checks.expr: main_score IS NULL OR CASE survey_type WHEN 'NPS' THEN main_score BETWEEN 2 AND 7 ELSE main_score BETWEEN 1 AND 4 END
checks.description: Score lies on the truncated scale the KPIs were calibrated on (NPS 2-7, CSAT/CES 1-4); failures mean the source scale changed.

checks.name: nps_category_only_for_nps
checks.expr: (survey_type = 'NPS') OR (nps_category IS NULL AND nps_category_raw IS NULL)
checks.description: Only NPS surveys carry an NPS category.

checks.name: nps_category_matches_raw
checks.expr: nps_category_raw IS NULL OR nps_category = nps_category_raw
checks.description: The recomputed category equals the delivered one wherever the latter exists.

checks.name: process_date_not_after_event
checks.expr: process_date IS NULL OR event_date IS NULL OR process_date <= event_date
checks.description: The interaction's business day never falls after the survey.

checks.name: comment_and_sentiment_paired
checks.description: A comment sentiment exists exactly when a comment exists (random missingness breaks this).

checks.name: question_text_and_response_paired
checks.expr: (question_1_text IS NULL) = (question_1_response IS NULL) AND (question_2_text IS NULL) = (question_2_response IS NULL) AND (question_3_text IS NULL) = (question_3_response IS NULL)
checks.description: Each answered question has its text and each asked question has an answer (random missingness breaks this).
